# AMD OnPrem model catalog

Every free AI model on AMD's internal OnPrem gateway (`llm-api.amd.com/OnPrem`): chat models
(GLM, Qwen, GPT-oss, Gemma, Llama, DeepSeek), embedding models, rerankers and decision models,
with context windows, capacity, pricing and 7-day usage. The list refreshes every 60 seconds from
the gateway, and models added upstream show a "new" badge the moment they land.

Use `/api/models` for the JSON form (browser-safe; the API key stays server-side).
